dependencies.reason: Provides PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE (read to gate the endpoint), the refs/hub/replaced/<branch> backup-ref convention this endpoint reuses, the origin_sync_state/origin_sha/origin_synced_at patch columns and PatchStore.SetOriginSyncState method this endpoint writes through, and the patch-status dashboard this spec extends with replaced_sha.

Provides the git server's per-ref pre-receive interception mechanism (the guarded storer wrapper / batch-split merge around git-receive-pack and its rejection-map shape) that this spec reuses, unconditionally, to reject pushes into refs/hub/replaced/*.

tasks.title: Gate reset-to-origin on auth, workspace mode/state and PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE
steps: Write TS-05-1 through TS-05-7 in a new internal/carrypatch/reset_to_origin_test.go, reusing testhelpers_test.go's createWorkspacesTable/createPatchesTable/seedWorkspace and the rebuildTestAuthMiddleware/rebuildUserAuth/rebuildPATAuth helpers to stand up an echo group with the new route mounted; confirm all seven fail because the route does not exist yet

Create internal/carrypatch/reset_to_origin.go defining ResetToOriginAPIConfig{DB *sql.DB; WorkspaceRoot string; NewGitRunner func(repoPath string) (GitRunner, error); GetVariable GetVariableFunc; PatchStore PatchStore; Audit audit.Emitter} and RegisterResetToOriginRoutes(api *echo.Group, cfg ResetToOriginAPIConfig) mounting api.POST("/workspaces/:slug/patches/:id/reset-to-origin", handleResetToOrigin(cfg))

Implement handleResetToOrigin(cfg) following handleRollbackRebuild's structure: 401 'authentication required' when apikit.GetAuthInfo(c) is nil; 403 'missing required scope: patches:write' when isPAT(auth) && !hasScope(auth, "patches:write"); 404 via authorizeWorkspace(c, cfg.DB, auth, slug), identical for a nonexistent workspace and a non-owner's

Query `SELECT workspace_mode, status, clone_status, integration_branch FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?`; return 400 'reset-to-origin is only supported for carry_patch workspaces' when mode != carry_patch, 400 'workspace is not active' when status != active, 400 'workspace clone is not ready' when cloneStatus != ready

Read cfg.GetVariable("workspace", slug, "PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE"); when the value (treating an error as unset) is not exactly "origin", call apikit.WriteAPIErrorWithType(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "reset-to-origin requires PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin", "patch_branch_source_mismatch") and return nil

After the PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE gate passes, temporarily return c.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "gate_passed"}) with a comment marking it as a placeholder that Task 2 replaces with the patch lookup and eligibility gate, and Task 3 replaces again with the real reset -- not a panic or TODO
Confirm TS-05-1 through TS-05-7 pass; run go vet ./internal/carrypatch/...

When the patch's branch_name equals the integration_branch already fetched in Task 1's workspace query, return 400 'cannot reset the integration branch'

Leave a new placeholder success return (e.g. c.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "eligible", "branch_name": branchName})) for every other status (active, conflict, disabled, merged_upstream), to be replaced by Task 3's real reset
Confirm TS-05-9, TS-05-10 and TS-05-11 pass; run go vet ./internal/carrypatch/...

tasks.title: Perform the backup-then-move reset under the workspace lock
steps: Write TS-05-8, TS-05-12 and TS-05-13 through TS-05-19 in reset_to_origin_test.go, supplying cfg.NewGitRunner with the mockGitRunner from testhelpers_test.go whose RunFunc branches on args to simulate `rev-parse --verify refs/remotes/origin/<branch>`, `rev-parse --verify refs/heads/<branch>`, `symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD`, and records `update-ref` calls; confirm they fail

Replace Task 2's placeholder with: acquire `unlock, locked := wslock.TryLock(slug)`; on !locked return 409 with message text exactly 'workspace_busy' (per 05-REQ-3.1's contract) without reading or writing any ref, and `defer unlock()` once acquired

Open `git, err := cfg.NewGitRunner(filepath.Join(cfg.WorkspaceRoot, slug, "trunk"))`; resolve `originSHA, err := git.Run(ctx, "rev-parse", "--verify", "refs/remotes/origin/"+branchName)`; on error return 400 'branch not found on origin; sync the workspace first' without fetching and without any update-ref call

Resolve `localSHA, localErr := git.Run(ctx, "rev-parse", "--verify", "refs/heads/"+branchName)`; when localErr == nil, run `git.Run(ctx, "update-ref", "refs/hub/replaced/"+branchName, localSHA)` before moving the branch, unconditionally (even when localSHA == originSHA); when localErr != nil, skip the backup call entirely
In both cases move the branch with `git.Run(ctx, "update-ref", "refs/heads/"+branchName, originSHA)`, never checkout or reset
Call `checkedOut, _ := git.Run(ctx, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD")`; when it equals branchName, call `git.HardReset(ctx, originSHA)` immediately after the ref move

Keep the backup-written flag and both SHAs in local variables for Task 4 to persist and report; for now return `c.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "reset", "branch_name": branchName, "origin_sha": originSHA})` as a placeholder Task 4 replaces with the full persisted response

Confirm TS-05-8 (loop over PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY values, asserting 200 and that GetVariable is never called with "PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY"), TS-05-12 (loop over eligible statuses, asserting 200), and TS-05-13 through TS-05-19 all pass
Run go vet ./internal/carrypatch/...
